versions.summary: Updates arrive by themselves, a changelog in the app, a reminder about background activity.
new: Update check: once a day, only with consent; download and install from the chat list
“What’s new” after an update and in About
“Background activity” reminder in the chat list: on Xiaomi it opens Battery saver directly
Swipe right in a chat — back to the chat list
A gallery photo in the attach panel opens full screen
Emoji groups switch with a sideways swipe
fixed: A crash in the chat feed when replying with a quote
In groups, the last message of a block no longer stands apart
Selecting a message no longer highlights the gap below it
Fast scrolling loads older messages in time

versions.summary: Third beta: fixes and wishes from the second round of testing.
new: Clear attachments by chat and by type
Groups look like direct chats; “reachable” in groups
Reactions and delete confirmation in Saved messages
Profile photos open in the common viewer
fixed: A crash in the chat feed during screen transitions
Smoother scrolling in long chats, the APK is ~10 MB smaller
Android 7–9: the attach panel no longer spends memory on full-size photos

versions.summary: Second beta: fixes and wishes from the first days of testing.
new: The full emoji set, search by words
fixed: A large download no longer delays messages
Attachments keep their proportions; camera photos are no longer on their side
The “Connecting to network” screen is gone: chats open at once

versions.summary: First public beta of Peerage: a messenger without servers.
new: Direct chats, groups, files, voice messages and calls, end-to-end encrypted over the Yggdrasil mesh
